name: io.github.PugarHuda/utuh-mcp
description: Hold the watcher role on Creditcoin's Attestcoin Protocol: sweep bonded completeness claims against Ethereum across independent endpoints, refute one that omits an in-scope event for half its bond, and audit what Creditcoin's attestors signed against Ethereum itself. No account, no server, no key to look.
title: Utuh watcher

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A funded Creditcoin CC3 Testnet key, needed only by refute_claim — which also demands confirm: true. Every other tool reads the chain and spends nothing.
